description: Create a new custom entity type (table) in the active workspace. Schema-mutating operation requiring administrative permissions. Newly created tables automatically include system columns such as `<tableName>id` (PK) and `displayname` (required when inserting rows). Check `list_tables` first to avoid duplicates; use `add_field` afterwards to add custom columns or lookups. Returns `{ entityType: { id, tableName, displayName, dataSourceType, workspaceId } }`.

tableName.description: Unique lowercase system name for the new table (e.g. `customer_feedback`). Required.

name: create_table
